name: Cynthia McKnight
current_role: Deputy Chief of Staff, U.S. Department of Labor (since May 2026)
summary: Cynthia McKnight is a deputy chief of staff in the Labor Department’s Office of the Secretary, named on May 1, 2026. She was previously chief of staff and senior counselor to Keith Sonderling while he was deputy secretary of labor, and moved up with him when he became acting secretary.
